note: Both sets correctly capture the sheet number A-301, title BUILDING SECTIONS, lot number 116, the 3/8"=1'-0" scales for sections C1 (West) and A1 (East), and the FINISHED FLOOR 2'-9 1/2" / GRADE LEVEL 0'-0" datums. Set A, though heavily redundant, misstates only three claims (two Grade Level elevations given as 2'-9 1/2" and one invented 2' 3 1/2" finished-floor height). Set B invents or misbinds more values: finished floor 2'-5 1/2" and 2'-3 1/2", grade level 2'-0" for both modules, and two Grade Level elevations of 2'-9 1/2", none of which appear in the source. Set A therefore has more faithful claims and fewer errors.
